## Data scraping
- Data scraping is cool!
  - Sometimes it goes against website licenses, so you need to be careful
    - Are you using the data ethically? Will you harm anyone with the data?
  - Some websites have APIs that you can access their data from
- For this course: you don't need to worry too much
  - Instant Data Scraper
  - I did not like their Privacy Policy on Data Collection
  - [Alternative](https://github.com/Lygobate/Open-scraper-chrome-extention)

## Extra context regarding data scraping
- Scripts to extract data
- Lots of requests to servers
  - Server overload, can't fulfill everyone's request quickly
  - Bad for real users
  - Hosting costs money
- If the website is a large database that has been worked over a long time
  - Scraping dismisses their hard work

## Sentiment Analysis
- NLP: Natural Language Processing
  - Widely used choice: Python
  - [Natural Language Toolkit](https://www.nltk.org/)
- Techniques used:
  - Tokenization, stemming, lemmatization, stopwords
- It's cool, but be wary
  - Small datasets can give inexact results

## Sentiment Analysis cont.
- Themes
  - Example: Business
  - Reviews may have feedback themes like delivery, support service, pricing
- Symbolic approach
  - Using rules and/or phrasebooks to code phrases

## Score types
- Polarity: Classifies the statement into Negative, Neutral, or Positive
  - Very negative: -1, Neutral: 0, Very Positive: 1
- Subjectivity: How opinion-based (Range 0 - 1)
  - 1 is subjective
  - Under 0.5 is leaning towards fact/objective
  - 0 is objective
- Objectivity: How fact-based (Range 0 - 1)
  - 1 is objective
  - Under 0.5 is leaning towards opinion/subjective
  - 0 is subjective
- Emotion scores:
  - Values and labels

## World Cloud
Pros: 
- Engaging and interactive
- Fast
  - Size corresponds to the frequency
Cons:
- We're bad at decoding size
- Colours should be strategically used
  - Red corresponds to negative words
  - Green for good
  - Red/Pink for love
  - Blue for sad
